text:
amanda: FYI — after the RBAC change this morning, svc-payments in us-east-1 is failing mTLS handshakes when calling proxy-eu (eu-west-1). saw a bunch of 526 TLS errors in the logs.

raj: thanks, noticed similar errors from svc-analytics. error shows: "tls: handshake failure" followed by KMS decrypt denied in the proxy logs.

kai: can you paste the exact log lines? also which RBAC change rolled?

amanda: rolling change was: removed legacy service account group 'legacy-services' and moved a few services to 'platform-services' role. I reproduced quickly: 
```
openssl s_client -connect proxy-eu.internal:443 -cert /tmp/svc-cert.pem -key /tmp/svc-key.pem
CONNECTED(00000003)
139742... error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate unknown\n
proxy logs: "kms:Decrypt permission denied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/abcd1234"\n```

lina: that KMS arn belongs to the cert keystore key in eu-west-1. RBAC change likely removed the iam:Decrypt permission for the service role used by the proxy.

raj: quick triage plan: 1) verify which service role/instance profile svc-payments and proxy-eu are using 2) check KMS key policy + iam bindings 3) confirm certs weren't rotated mid-change 4) restore minimal decrypt permission as emergency if needed.

kai: +1. Also check audit logs for the RBAC migration script — it may have applied an overly broad deny. audit logs path: /var/log/rbac-migrations/2026-03-15.log — grep for proxy-eu.

amanda: I checked: migration script touched the group mapping for platform-services and added a deny on kms:Decrypt for principals matching /legacy-.*/ unintentionally.

deploy-bot: Automated job cert-rotation-eu started at 1777770025 by deploy pipeline #2143.

lina: that explains the timing. If cert-rotation started while decrypt was denied, proxy would fail to unwrap new private keys.

raj: remediation suggestion: temporarily add iam:Decrypt to the proxy principal for the specific key and roll back the deny in the migration script. Then re-run rotation. We should scope the allow to the specific kms:key arn.

kai: policy snippet to apply (minimal):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/proxy-eu-role"},
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234"
    }
  ]
}
```

amanda: I'll open a scoped emergency PR and tag infra oncall. also adding an audit alert to detect any future migration script that includes kms denies.

raj: postmortem action items: 1) add unit tests to RBAC migration scripts to reject wildcard deny rules on kms:* 2) add pre-check that cert-rotation jobs verify key access before starting 3) add region-aware playbook for cross-region mTLS failures.

lina: I'll own the playbook doc. include checklist: check instance profile, kms policy, cert age, and s_client test.

kai: once warmed up, let's also add a guard in console: warn if a migration would remove kms:Decrypt from any principal currently attached to an active cert-rotation job.

amanda: thanks all — executing emergency rollback now and will update in this thread when rotation completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: cert-rotation-eu completed (partial) at 1777770058 — 3/5 nodes rotated, 2 failed due to decrypt error.

amanda: rollback applied, re-triggering rotation after permissions fix. will report success/failure here.

raj: nice work. capture the exact migration diff in the postmortem.

lina: noted. I'll start the playbook draft and link it here.

amanda: update — rotation succeeded after permission fix, all services passed mTLS checks. closing the emergency incident and filing follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
